By following [Lom14, Proposition 3.1], if α ∈ Pic 0 ( X ) is a topologically trivial line bundle such that H 0 ( X,ω ⊗ k 0 X ⊗ α ) = 0 for some k 0 ∈ Z , then R (id X , α ) = (id Y , β ) for some β ∈ Pic 0 ( Y ) and moreover there are isomorphisms R k : H 0 ( X,ω ⊗ k X ⊗ α ) → H 0 ( Y, ω ⊗ k Y ⊗ β ) for all k ∈ Z . As in [Tod06], one can prove that if E ∈ ∣ ∣ ω ⊗ k X ⊗ α ∣ ∣ and E ′ = R k ( E ) ∈ ∣ ∣ ω ⊗ k Y ⊗ β ∣ ∣ is the corresponding divisor, then F restricts to an equivalence of triangulated categories D b Supp( E ) (Coh( X )) ≃ D b Supp( E ′ ) (Coh( Y )).
